invalidation.invalidation_detail: Reclassify the descending trading state if price reclaims and holds above the short moving-average cluster and nearby resistance while subsequent swings establish a higher-high/higher-low sequence; otherwise retain the transition-to-descending hierarchy.

hard_anchors: Deterministic short-term structure is coherent descending, while long-term structure remains transition, establishing a downward trading move within an unresolved higher-timeframe regime.
Price is below the short EMA cluster and below the intermediate and long SMA references; only the short SMA10 remains below price, so moving-average evidence is predominantly negative.
The latest bearish-engulfing candle confirms renewed near-term seller control after the recent rebound attempt.
The current session returned into a prior bullish imbalance near immediate support, creating localized opposing support evidence but not a confirmed structural reclaim.
Short-horizon ATR is materially below ATR14, indicating realized range is cooling from the earlier expansion, while ATR14 remains elevated relative to price.
Latest volume is below its 20-session average and two of the latest three sessions show below-average participation, indicating volume contraction rather than broad downside participation.
A bearish flag follows the documented sharp downside impulse; the bullish fair-value-gap and neutral mitigation-block detections are lower-confidence counterevidence.
event_modifiers: No dated earnings release, macroeconomic print, policy decision, filing, or identifiable idiosyncratic shock was supplied as a dominant driver for this date.
narrative_residual: Research-manager fundamental advocacy, valuation comments, and directional recommendations were excluded from state estimation.
Qualitative claims concerning cash generation, leverage, medical costs, goodwill, and technical optimism were treated as low-weight residual context only.
contradictory_signals: Long-term structure is transition rather than confirmed descending, whereas both trading and lower timeframes are descending.
The price has returned into a bullish fair-value-gap/support zone despite the bearish engulfing pattern and bearish flag.
Range compression in ATR5 relative to ATR14 conflicts with the still-elevated medium-horizon realized range.
Contracted volume weakens confirmation of the active bearish impulse.
